· 현재가($2,507.4) vs SMA5($2,481.95)/SMA20($2,192.59)/SMA50($2,005.75): 단기·중기 추세 상회, 강세 위치 진단

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (79.8→72.9): 과매수 구간 냉각 중, 하락 압력 증가 가능성
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (62.1217→25.2861): 개선세 둔화, 강세 모멘텀 약화 신호

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 2,520.41 저항선 돌파 여부 확인 후 진입 고려, 현재는 관망
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,507.4) vs SMA5 ($2,481.95)/SMA20 ($2,192.59)/SMA50 ($2,005.75): short-to-mid term trend above, indicating strong position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($1,889.3)/SMA200 ($2,020.52): mid-to-long term trend strength advantage.
· 52-week position (30.7%) + current price level near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (79.8→72.9): cooling from overbought territory, potential for increased downward pressure.
· MACD histogram trajectory (62.1217→25.2861): slowing improvement, signal of weakening bullish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $2,759.19): approaching upper band, caution for overheating.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,443.96): support based on pivot and SMA20.
· Swing resistance ($2,520.41): need to confirm further upside potential upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): confirmation of continued uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.47x): low volume relative to continued rise, reduced confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): consider entry after confirming breakout above resistance at $2,520.41, currently wait-and-see.
